issues.description: Same-rank terminal records update unconditionally, so an older FAILED/TIMEOUT/etc. snapshot can overwrite a newer terminal record.
The unchanged check only compares state, end, and elapsed_sec, so corrected user/partition/CPU/GPU/exit_code data is silently ignored.
Unknown Slurm states are treated as terminal, causing in-progress states like CONFIGURING, REQUEUED, or RESIZING to interact incorrectly with stale-skip logic.
Timestamps are stored and compared as raw text, which gives incorrect ordering/filtering when timezone offsets or mixed timestamp forms are present.
Negative AllocCPUS and negative gres/gpu values are accepted, allowing negative CPU/GPU-hour reports.
Rows with submit, start, and end all missing are accepted but disappear from all time-filtered reports and top-user windows.
Read-only report commands use the same connect path as ingest, so a typo or missing DB path silently creates an empty database.
The default database directory and file are created with process umask defaults, which can expose job/user accounting data on shared systems.
The schema has no indexes for reference-time, user, partition, or state report queries, so reports become full-table scans at Slurm accounting scale.
